description: Large/reinforced packaging scenario. SF material table includes several large or anti-pressure cartons at 10-15 yuan.

Sensitivity only: reinforced 15-yuan packaging and incremental route cost attributed to fuel (18.6/8.2 L per 100 km x 7.60 yuan/L). Excludes labor, depreciation, tolls, maintenance and insurance; it does not replace the full-cost baseline.
